product.name: Polymorphic Computing Chip Technology
product.description: Reconfigurable AI chips that adapt hardware configurations via software to optimize energy efficiency and performance for diverse AI models.

product.name: Learnable Function Unit (LFU)
product.description: A hardware component within Exa's chips that approximates any univariate function asynchronously, enabling dynamic AI model computations with reduced latency and power.

product.name: Open-source SDK and Firmware
product.description: Software development kit and firmware supporting Exa's polymorphic chips, enabling integration with popular AI frameworks and facilitating hardware programmability.
